evidence.quote: Language of instruction English All courses and exams are offered in the language of instruction.
Courses are held entirely in English.
At Rhein-Waal University of Applied Sciences, you do not pay tuition fees, as it is a state university in North Rhine-Westphalia.
You can then use these details to apply via uni-assist.

notes: The DAAD page states tuition fees per semester None and the university's costs page confirms no tuition fees as a state university in NRW. The application deadline is given as 15 July for the winter semester, but the year is not stated, so the date is left null in the intake. The application channel is uni-assist for international applicants; the pages do not mention a VPD requirement. The teaching language is English; German language skills are not required.

evidence.quote: Admission restrictions: Please note that this degree programme is subject to admission restrictions (NC).

To start your degree with us, you must meet one of the following requirements: an Unrestricted university entrance qualification or an Entrance qualification for university of applied sciences a qualification recognised as equivalent or a vocational qualification, e.g. as a master craftsman or through technical college education
